note: Shared cases for the two checks that the companion's Source scripts lie under the installed CI Source (DESIGN section 33): src/companion.mjs#assertSourceScripts (package build, companion start) and windows/verify-resident.ps1#Test-CompanionSourceScripts (verify). test/r4-first-halt.test.mjs runs the JavaScript side over this file with the install root C:\ProgramData\CluedIndependentCI\resident; windows/test-resident-windows.ps1 runs the PowerShell side over it with a scratch root (the accepted paths exist there). {root} is the install root, {sha} the CI Source hash the install is for, {other} an older Source hash, {base} = {root}\source\{sha}. The refused cases name the key that is refused first; a refused case whose other script is fine puts the good path in the other key.

accepted.name: the root with a trailing backslash is the same root
names with dots, at signs and dashes

refused.name: relay script in an older Source (the 2026-10-29 case)
bundle script in an older Source (the 2026-10-29 case)
both in an older Source: the first key is named
the resident directory instead of the Source
a sibling whose name only starts with the hash
the Source directory with a closing backslash
a parent segment out of the Source
a parent segment into another Source
